【Sharing the lot calculation tool I've been using recently ♪】

In trading day to day while watching charts, I think the thing everyone finds troublesome is lot calculation.

Both on YouTube and in my PDF materials,

I have previously shared one convenient free calculation tool, saying

"I calculate with this site's calculator~"

but it has these drawbacks:

※ Each calculation takes time.

※ Entering the entry and stop-loss figures every time is a hassle

※ If you make a typo in the numbers, the lot goes off and risks causing unexpected losses.

※ So you often have the trouble of double-checking because you worry whether it's really correct.

I can't deny these.

If the scenario has been clear for several hours and you have time before entry it's still fine, but when you want to enter right away, you get flustered, right?

And when you're flustered mistakes are more likely, a vicious cycle.

If you have no time before entry and the calculation is a nuisance, you can't concentrate on chart analysis either, so misjudgments become more likely.

So after searching around, I found a super convenient calculation tool, and I'm using it now.

It's a tool called "Easy Order". (This links to my blog article.)
↓
https://t.co/Azj2Bpufgm

As I explain in detail in the blog, what's convenient is that you don't need to type in numbers and calculate; just slide three horizontal lines (entry, stop loss, take profit) up and down on MT4!!

Just by moving the horizontal lines up and down with an intuitive feel like "stop loss is around here, entry around here," it automatically calculates the appropriate lot size!

Moreover, market, limit, and stop orders can be placed with one click!

Using this, you know the appropriate lot size in seconds without doing the tedious calculation, so deciding the lot before entry becomes revolutionarily easy ♪

The risk-reward ratio is also displayed automatically.

It's a god-tier tool that instantly resolves all the stress, hassle, difficulty, and anxiety of "what if I make a mistake" that you've had with lot and risk-reward calculations.

It also supports overseas FX companies like XM, which I use, and it supports CFDs and crypto symbols besides currency pairs.

So you don't need to split things up, like using this tool for currencies and a different tool for crypto.

It's not free, of course, but at 4,500 yen the price is very reasonable, which is another appeal.

Considering that you'll be freed from the hassle of lot calculation every time and that with a single purchase lot and risk-reward calculations will be easier from now on, I'm sure it's a good deal.

Looking at X, quite a few people who trade with the same method as me are already using this tool.

https://t.co/Azj2Bpufgm

No exaggeration, you're freed from all the hassle of lot calculation, it gets massively easier, and you can concentrate only on chart analysis.

I really recommend it to those who struggle with lot or risk-reward calculations or feel they're bad at them, so I'll quietly share it on a Saturday night 😁
